feeds.title: Tissuepathology.
feeds.description: This blog was started in 2007 to educate and inform the pathology and laboratory community about emerging technologies in pathology. Since its inception, they strive to provide relevant news items, product information and commentary on issues of relevance to healthcare and the practice of pathology and laboratory medicine with an emphasis on technology.

feeds.title: Dark Daily EBriefings
feeds.description: An ebriefing service that provides news for diagnostic medicine professionals, clinical laboratory or pathology groups, lab suppliers and diagnostics. Dark Daily is a concise e-news/management briefing on timely topics in clinical laboratory and anatomic pathology group management.

feeds.title: Medscape Pathology & Lab Medicine Headlines
feeds.description: Get the latest medical news, thought leader perspective, clinical trial coverage, drug updates, journal articles, CME activities & more on Medscape. A free resource for physicians.

feeds.title: PathologyWatch Blog
feeds.description: PathologyWatch Blog is a digital pathology blog that offers insights and perspectives on how digital pathology is transforming the field of pathology. Founded in 2019 by Dr. Mark Boguski and Dr. Joel Mortensen, PathologyWatch's blog covers topics such as AI-powered diagnostics, lab automation, and cloud-based image management.

feeds.title: Tissuepathology.com
feeds.description: Blog educates and informs the pathology and laboratory community about emerging technologies in pathology. Featuring relevant news items, product information and commentary on issues of relevance to healthcare and the practice of pathology and laboratory medicine with an emphasis on technology, advances in digital pathology, personalized medicine, Pathology 2.0, deep learning and research and development.

feeds.title: Digital Pathology Place Blog
feeds.description: Providing high-quality informational content about different aspects of digital pathology. Digital Pathology Place is on a mission to bridge the gap between pathologists and computer scientists.

feeds.title: Pathology Made Simple
feeds.description: Pathology Made Simple is a website created by Dr Vijay Shankar for you, the students of Pathology.

feeds.title: Voicebrook Blog
feeds.description: Tips, Tricks, Advice and anecdotes on how to save time, money and lives using pathology speech recognition and reporting software. Voicebrook is the leading provider of speech recognition and digital dictation reporting solutions for Anatomic Pathology laboratories.

feeds.title: Creepy Dreadful Wonderful Parasites
feeds.description: A parasite case of the week blog specializing in human parasites tells different parasite cases along with the answers to the previous case. Follow this site to know more about different types of parasite cases.

feeds.title: Corista Blog
feeds.description: Since its founding in 2005, Corista has been dedicated to the goal of a digital clinical pathology workflow platform that delivers speed, accuracy, and ease of use that far surpasses traditional pathology workflow. Corista provides Image Centric Digital Pathology for physicians and patients, in real-time.

feeds.title: Pathology In Practice
feeds.description: Pathology in Practice was launched in 2000 to provide commercial companies with the option of an independently published business magazine having a direct route to the buyers and decision-makers of the UK's clinical laboratory market. The website of Pathology In Practice Magazine informs readers of the latest advances and current issues affecting professionals in the hospital laboratory sector.

feeds.title: Pathology Student
feeds.description: Pathology Student is an educational website for medical students, dental students, or anyone else interested in pathology. They make pathology easy and fun!

feeds.title: Lablogatory - Pathology
feeds.description: A blog for medical laboratory professionals.

feeds.title: GomerBlog - Pathology
feeds.description: Earth's Finest Medical News Satire Site for Pathology Professionals. Their goal is to provide comic relief to our hard working healthcare professionals.

feeds.title: Neuropathology blog
feeds.description: Author Brian E. Moore discusses issues about the practice of neuropathology including nervous system tumors, neuroanatomy, neurodegenerative disease, muscle and nerve disorders, ophthalmologic pathology, neuro trivia, neuropathology gossip, job listings and anything else that might be of interest to a blue-collar neuropathologist.

feeds.title: MicroMedEd
feeds.description: This is a weekly blog initiative aimed at providing explanations of key microbiological concepts, advances, and terms to help clinicians, scientists, students, and the public better engage with microbial science. I hope you find these resources useful and enjoy interacting with the clinical microbiology and pathology community on this blog.

feeds.title: Forensic Pathology Forum
feeds.description: Dr. Judy Melinek, a board-certified forensic pathologist and author blogs about forensic pathology and science in the news.

feeds.title: TimAllenMDJD
feeds.description: Allen is a professor at The University of Texas Medical Branch Galveston, Texas, Department of Pathology. Widely published and active member of the College of American Pathologists.

feeds.title: PATHOLOGIST WORLD by Dr. Juan J. Barcia
feeds.description: A way to exchange knowledge, experiences, opinions and anything in the world of pathology

feeds.title: Lab Soft News
feeds.description: An Idea Factory for Pathology Informatics and the Clinical Laboratory. Presented by the Pathology Education Consortium (PEC).

feeds.title: MedPage Today - Pathology
feeds.description: Pathology Headlines by MedPage Today. MedPage Today, is a CE and CME accredited medical news service, provides free continuing education to healthcare professionals in addition to the latest news.

feeds.title: Modern Pathology
feeds.description: Modern Pathology features diagnostic anatomic pathology and contains original scientific papers, selected short courses, appropriate special lectures, reviews, editorials, letters to the editor, and Academy News. In many ways, it reflects the instructive and informative composition of the Academy's annual meeting.

feeds.title: Clinical Lab Manager Blog
feeds.description: Covering the latest trends in leadership, safety and lab products to help clinical laboratory leaders manage their labs more effectively.

feeds.title: Digital Pathology Association (DPA) Blog
feeds.description: The mission of the Digital Pathology Association is to facilitate education and awareness of digital pathology applications in healthcare. Digital pathology is rapidly gaining momentum as a proven and essential technology that is helping to reduce laboratory expenses, improve operational efficiency, enhance productivity, and improve treatment decisions and patient care.
